scenario: Trailing comma after the last name in a multi-line parenthesised selective import is permitted per LIMP.2.2.2. Pin: `from ha import (Light,)` (single name + trailing comma) parses cleanly. The grammar's `import_name_list` parenthesised alternative ends with `','?` allowing the optional trailing comma; LLEX.17.3 keeps the line continuation balanced. Symmetric with the no-trailing-comma form covered in LIMP.2.2.1.
rules_ds:
from ha import (
    Light,
)

rule r:
    Light l where l.is_on == true
->
    log info "x"

libraries.ha:
schema Light scope logical:
    is_on: Bool key
